pisos.metaDesc: Full or partial renovation of your apartment in Barcelona: kitchens, bathrooms, layout and premium finishes. Clear pricing and deadlines that are met.
pisos.heroSub: Full or partial renovation with in-house site management. An apartment designed down to the detail, delivered on time and with no price surprises.
pisos.i1: Kitchens: cabinetry, worktop, appliances and installation
pisos.i2: Bathrooms: plumbing, tiling, sanitaryware and screens
pisos.i3: Layout: partitions, demolition and new rooms
pisos.i5: Flooring, painting and bespoke interior joinery
pisos.q1: How much does it cost to renovate an apartment in Barcelona?
pisos.a1: It depends on the m², finish level and scope. A full renovation typically ranges from ~€450/m² (basic) to ~€950/m² (premium). Use the calculator for an instant estimate.
pisos.q2: How long does a full apartment renovation take?
pisos.a2: An average apartment (70–90 m²) is usually 8 to 12 weeks, depending on scope and permits. We give you a fixed schedule in the quote.
pisos.q3: Do I need a works permit?
pisos.a3: Renovations that don't touch structure or façade usually require a minor-works notice. We handle the necessary permits.
pisos.q4: Can I live in the apartment during the works?
pisos.a4: For partial renovations sometimes yes; for full ones it's best not to. We assess it at the visit.
pisos.a5: Yes. All our work is guaranteed, and materials carry their manufacturer's warranty.

casas.metaTitle: House renovation in Barcelona and Catalonia
casas.metaDesc: Full renovation of houses and detached homes in Barcelona and Catalonia. Technical design, premium finishes and a single point of contact.
casas.h1: House renovation in Barcelona and Catalonia
casas.heroSub: Detached homes renovated top to bottom, with technical design, premium finishes and a schedule that's met.
casas.i1: Full layout and renovation of every room
casas.q1: How much does it cost to renovate a house?
casas.a1: A full detached-home renovation typically ranges from ~€500/m² (basic) to ~€1,100/m² (premium), depending on size and finishes. The calculator gives you a range instantly.
casas.q2: Do I need an architect's design?
casas.a2: For renovations affecting structure, façade or major layout, yes. We coordinate the technical design and site management.
casas.q3: How long do the works take?
casas.a3: A complete house is usually 4 to 8 months depending on size and scope. We define the phases in the quote.
casas.a4: Yes, wherever regulations allow. We handle permits and legalisation as part of the project.
casas.q5: Do you work outside Barcelona city?
casas.a5: Yes, we travel across Catalonia for full home renovations.

oficinas.metaTitle: Office and retail renovation in Barcelona
oficinas.metaDesc: Office and commercial unit renovation in Barcelona: layout, systems, lighting and branding. Spaces ready to work, on schedule.
oficinas.h1: Office and retail renovation in Barcelona
oficinas.heroSub: Functional, on-brand workspaces, ready to operate. We schedule the works to minimise the impact on your activity.
oficinas.i4: Raised floors, flooring and suspended ceilings
oficinas.q1: How much does it cost to renovate an office or unit?
oficinas.a1: A full office renovation typically ranges from ~€400/m² (basic) to ~€900/m² (premium), depending on systems and finishes. Ask us for an estimate with the calculator.
oficinas.q2: Can you work at night or on weekends?
oficinas.a2: Yes. We adapt the works schedule to reduce the impact on your activity and your neighbours'.
oficinas.q3: Do you handle the activity licence?
oficinas.a3: Yes, we coordinate the necessary works and activity licences and the technical documentation.
oficinas.a4: Yes. From design to handover, with a single site manager and progress reports.
oficinas.a5: Yes, all work is guaranteed and materials carry their manufacturer's warranty.

construccion.metaTitle: Construction and minor works in Barcelona
construccion.metaDesc: Extensions, small-scale new build and structural renovations in Barcelona and Catalonia. Permits, technical design and guarantees in order.
construccion.h1: Construction and minor works in Barcelona
construccion.heroSub: Extensions, small-scale new build and structural renovations, with permits, technical design and guarantees in order.
construccion.q1: How is the price of a construction job calculated?
construccion.a1: Every job is unique: it depends on the design, floor area, structure and materials. We prepare a detailed quote after studying your case.
construccion.q2: Do I need a major-works permit?
construccion.a2: Extensions and structural works usually require a major-works permit and an architect's design. We handle all the paperwork.
construccion.q3: Do you include the technical design?
construccion.a3: Yes, we coordinate the design and site management with our technical team.
construccion.q4: How long do these works take?
construccion.a4: It depends on scope. We define a phased schedule in the quote and keep you updated on progress.
construccion.a5: Yes. The work is guaranteed and we comply with the legal building warranties.
